top20_migration_review.basis: Current FactorRecipeRegistry replacement_for, operator implementations, technical_macros_v2 and compat_research/lqtp allowlists; recommendations are advisory and no formulas were rewritten.

items.name: ROC
items.classification: recipe replacement exists; source calls are malformed
items.defaults_or_semantics: legacy ROC(price, window=10); recipe expands to 100 * ts_pct(x, window)
items.confidence: exact semantic replacement, but migration parameters unresolved
items.recommendation: Do not alias the 5-argument OHLCV calls. Recover intended price (normally Close) and explicit window, then expand/use rate_of_change.

items.name: BollingerUpper
items.classification: recipe replacement exists; mixed valid and malformed signatures
items.defaults_or_semantics: legacy defaults window=20, std_dev/width=2
items.confidence: exact when x/window/width are known
items.recommendation: Three-argument Close/window/width rows can migrate exactly; five-OHLCV rows require template repair and must not drop arguments automatically.

items.name: BollingerLower
items.classification: recipe replacement exists; mixed valid and malformed signatures
items.defaults_or_semantics: legacy defaults window=20, std_dev/width=2
items.confidence: exact when x/window/width are known
items.recommendation: Three-argument rows can migrate exactly; five-OHLCV rows need intended price/window recovery.

items.name: BollingerBands
items.classification: recipe replacement exists for middle band, not a multi-output band tuple
items.defaults_or_semantics: legacy BollingerBands returned only rolling mean; window=20; std_dev=2 was a dead argument
items.confidence: exact for legacy middle-band output after dropping only the documented dead std_dev
items.recommendation: Map valid legacy Close/window[/std_dev] calls to bollinger_mid; five-OHLCV rows remain malformed.

items.name: OBV
items.classification: legacy cumulative primitive moved; bounded recipe is not one-to-one
items.defaults_or_semantics: legacy OBV(close, volume) is cumulative full-history; replacement recipe requires explicit bounded window
items.confidence: not exact without a window/anchoring policy
items.recommendation: Needs semantic definition. Do not map five-OHLCV calls or cumulative OBV automatically to rolling_obv.

items.defaults_or_semantics: equal-activity-grid second/first difference squared ratio; buckets choices 8/16/32, default 16
items.confidence: name likely refers to same concept, but one-argument MinuteVolume samples cannot satisfy price+activity
items.recommendation: Needs source-template semantic repair identifying minute price and activity panels; no alias-only migration.

items.confidence: exact after correct input binding
